reason: A race's own components carry nothing a label reads: its ability scores come from SelectableRaceStat or its heritage selection, and its traits are features it grants, each summarized apart. Checked against the cached guides (~/code/wotr-planner/guide-cache).
text: Its heritage sets the ability scores (classic: +2 Dexterity and Charisma, -2 Strength). +1 to the DC of its enchantment spells, +2 on Perception and Mobility, can take human form.
